problem: The full Portal capability parity block existed in prijzen.html and all source-level checks passed, but Netlify's build pipeline regenerated the pricing intro and removed that block from the production artifact.
root_cause: pricing-build-integrity.mjs protects only section#pakketten. The parity block had been inserted before that canonical protected section, so downstream normalizers/build transforms could discard it while CI still passed.
prevention: Customer-visible pricing content that must survive production builds must live inside the canonical protected section#pakketten or be explicitly restored by pricing-build-integrity.mjs.
pricing-build-integrity.mjs must require the full Portal parity tokens so a build cannot silently drop the capability contract.
Production readback must verify built/public content, not only source HTML or commit identity.

evidence.production_observation: Netlify production commit 1fd9b6a6d0b6fb035f6351aaac3e690cbf8e9ed7 was exact, but /prijzen did not contain the parity block after build.
